definition: Sergey Levine is a computer scientist and professor at UC Berkeley specializing in robotics and machine learning.
details: He is a co-founder of the company Physical Intelligence.

explainer.lead: Sergey Levine is a Computer scientist and professor. His work spans reinforcement learning and robotics.

contributions.name: His group has contributed to methods that directly map high-dimensional sensory inputs, such as images, to motor actions using deep neural networks.
He contributed to end-to-end visuomotor policy learning, model-based reinforcement learning for sample-efficient control, and offline reinforcement learning from large robot datasets.

timeline.what: In 2015, Levine joined Google as a part-time research scientist to work on machine intelligence.
In 2016, Levine joined the faculty of the University of California, Berkeley, where he is a professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences.
